step1.title: This is Maya
step1.body: Maya has this gift for making hard things feel possible. She doesn't believe in willpower - she believes in systems. Small ones. The kind you don't even notice until they've changed your life.

step2.title: Start Embarrassingly Small
step2.body: Maya's philosophy? If you're not embarrassed by how small you're starting, you're starting too big. Want to exercise? Start with one pushup. Want to read? One page. She's relentless about this.

step3.title: Your First Conversation
step3.body: Tell Maya about one thing you've been meaning to do but keep putting off. She won't judge the delay - she'll help you find the tiniest possible first step.

maya.funFact: Maya once helped someone finally learn guitar by having them just hold it for 2 minutes a day. Three months later? First song.
maya.firstConversationPrompt: What's one small thing you've been putting off?

step1.title: This is Peter
step1.body: Peter sees patterns nobody else sees. He's part data scientist, part philosopher, part detective. When you share your life with him, he connects dots you didn't know existed.

step2.title: Finding Hidden Patterns
step2.body: Peter tracks what most people ignore - the small correlations between your mood, sleep, habits, and outcomes. Over time, he helps you understand yourself in ways that feel almost magical.

step3.title: Your First Conversation
step3.body: Peter would love to know about a recent decision you made - good or bad. He's curious about the factors that led to it, even the ones you might not have considered.

peter.funFact: Peter once predicted a user would get sick 3 days before they did, just from subtle changes in their conversation patterns.
peter.firstConversationPrompt: What's a decision you've been thinking about lately?

step1.title: This is Alex
step1.body: Alex is the person you wish you had in every difficult conversation. She's a communication coach who helps you say what you mean - and hear what others really mean.

step2.title: Words That Work
step2.body: Ever sent an email you regretted? Had a conversation go sideways? Alex helps you prepare for high-stakes moments and debrief the ones that didn't go as planned.

step3.title: Your First Conversation
step3.body: Tell Alex about a conversation you've been avoiding, or one that didn't go the way you hoped. She'll help you see it differently - and prepare for next time.

alex.funFact: Alex helped someone negotiate a 40% raise with just three sentences they'd never thought to say.
alex.firstConversationPrompt: Is there a conversation you've been putting off?

step1.title: This is Jordan
step1.body: Jordan turns vague dreams into actual plans. Not someday plans. Real ones, with dates and steps and backup options. She's obsessed with making your future feel as real as your present.

step2.title: Dreams into Dates
step2.body: That trip you've 'always wanted to take'? That project you'll start 'when you have time'? Jordan doesn't let those stay hypothetical. She makes them concrete.

step3.title: Your First Conversation
step3.body: Share something you've been wanting to do 'someday.' Jordan will help you figure out what 'someday' actually looks like - and take the first real step toward it.

jordan.funFact: Jordan helped someone plan their dream wedding in 6 weeks after they'd been 'figuring it out' for 2 years.
jordan.firstConversationPrompt: What's something you've always wanted to do but never planned?

step1.title: This is Nayan
step1.body: Nayan is different. Quieter. Deeper. He's the wise friend who asks the questions that stay with you for days. He's not here to fix problems - he's here to help you see them differently.

step2.title: The Long View
step2.body: While others focus on the next step, Nayan thinks in decades. He helps you connect today's small actions to the person you're becoming. His favorite phrase? 'Small, consistent actions create extraordinary results.'

step3.title: Your First Conversation
step3.body: Nayan doesn't do small talk. Tell him what you're really wrestling with - the big stuff. The meaning stuff. He's listening.

nayan.funFact: Nayan once answered a question with silence that lasted 30 seconds. The user said it was the most helpful thing anyone had ever done.
nayan.firstConversationPrompt: What's something you've been thinking about deeply lately?

futureInsights.intro: The longer we talk, the deeper I understand. Here's what our relationship will look like as we grow together.

intro1.text: Hello! My name is [your name] and I'm creating a voice clone. Today is a beautiful day and I'm excited to get started with this project.
intro1.tip: Speak naturally at your normal pace

intro2.text: I love spending time with my friends and family. We often go to the park together, or sometimes we'll just stay home and watch movies.
intro2.tip: Imagine telling a friend about your weekend

intro3.text: One of my favorite things to do is read books. I especially enjoy science fiction and mystery novels. There's nothing quite like getting lost in a good story.

emotion1.text: I'm so happy to hear that news! That's absolutely wonderful, congratulations! I knew you could do it!

emotion2.text: I understand how difficult that must have been. Take your time, I'm here for you whenever you need to talk.

emotion3.text: Hmm, that's interesting. Let me think about that for a moment. I wonder if there might be another way to approach this problem.

range1.text: Can you believe it? I just won the lottery! Well, not really, but wouldn't that be amazing? One can dream, right?
range1.tip: Vary your pitch - go high and low

range2.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers. She sells seashells by the seashore.
range2.tip: Enunciate clearly - these test different sounds

range3.text: Wait... Did you hear that? I think someone's at the door. Let me go check. Oh, it's just the wind.
range3.tip: Use pauses and vary your tempo

conversation1.text: So anyway, I was telling them about the project, and they seemed really interested. They asked a lot of questions, which I thought was a good sign.

conversation2.text: Let me tell you about my day. First, I had breakfast - just some toast and coffee. Then I went for a walk around the neighborhood.
